title: Redlines Alignment Benchmark Labels
description: Schema for one pair's ground-truth label file (ADR-0034, D-7): the correspondences, insertions, deletions, splits, merges and unscored regions the alignment metric (#143) scores against, plus the provenance, review and move-verdict records that make the numbers trustworthy. Written by the synthetic generator (#141) or a human labeller (#142) and read by benchmark/labels.py, which additionally checks two things this schema cannot: that every digest still matches the block it names, and that every text-bearing block (plus table row blocks; containers -- document, section, table -- are never labelled) appears exactly once across correspondences, inserted, deleted, splits, merges and unscored.

schema.description: The label format's own version, so a future format change can be detected before it is silently misread.

pair.description: A short, unique name for this pair, used in the report and in file paths (e.g. 'csa-1.1-to-2.0').

correspondences.description: Every matched pair, including unchanged ones -- the metric's denominator needs them (ADR-0034).

inserted.description: Test-side blocks with no source counterpart.

deleted.description: Source-side blocks with no test counterpart.

splits.description: One source block became several test blocks. Labelled now so the 1.1 metric has data; excluded from every 1.0 denominator (#141).

merges.description: Several source blocks became one test block. Labelled now, not scored in 1.0.

unscored.description: Regions deliberately left out of the correspondence set, with a stated reason (e.g. a baseline that cannot address table rows).

move_verdicts.description: Reviewer rulings on engine-reported moves that are not in `correspondences` (ADR-0009's move gate). Fail-closed: an engine move with no verdict here fails the gate exactly as `verdict: wrong` does.

address.description: An ADR-0029 block address, e.g. '/section[1]/list_item[3]'. Never the root '/': containers, including the document root, are never labelled.

digest.description: The first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of the block's normalised text (whitespace collapsed, label re-prefixed where the block has one; a table row's content is its cells' texts). Verified on load; a mismatch means the labels are stale (ADR-0034).

status.description: 'proposed': written by the generator or `label.py init`, not yet looked at by a human. 'confirmed': a human looked and agreed. 'corrected': a human looked and changed it -- the row that feeds `override_rate`.

file.description: The document file's name within the pair's directory.

format.description: The reader format ('text', 'markdown', ...) this side is read as.

profile.description: The structure profile name this side is read under.

sha256.description: sha256 of the committed file's exact bytes, so a labels file always names a specific, checkable document.

kind.description: Which corpus tier this pair belongs to (ADR-0034); the two must stay separate (ADR-0021).

origin.description: Where the source documents came from, e.g. 'CommonPaper/CSA tags 1.1 and 2.0' or 'tests/corpus/sample_pair + plan:heavy'.

licence.description: The upstream document's licence, when the pair is hand-labelled from a licensed source.

attribution.description: The attribution line to publish alongside the pair, when the licence requires one.

prepared_by.description: The script that produced the committed, prepared text, e.g. 'benchmark/prepare.py'.

normalisations.description: Every deterministic transformation `prepared_by` applied, named, so a reader of the corpus can trust the provenance rather than diffing against upstream by hand.

generator.description: Synthetic pairs only: the module that produced this pair, e.g. 'benchmark/generate.py'.

generator_version.description: Synthetic pairs only: the generator's own version, bumped deliberately (ADR-0034).

seed.description: Synthetic pairs only: the seed the generator's own `random.Random` instance was constructed with.

plan.description: Synthetic pairs only: the named mutation plan applied (e.g. 'heavy', 'move-heavy').

kind.description: 'same': parents correspond and labels match (or neither side has one) -- unchanged or edited in place. 'move': parents do not correspond, or the pair crosses another pair in its scope. 'renumber': parents correspond but the labels differ. A block can be both moved and relabelled; record 'move' and let the differing labels carry the renumber (ADR-0034).

source_label.description: The source block's label, or null if it has none.

test_label.description: The test block's label, or null if it has none.

region.description: An address, or a description of the region, excluded from scoring.

side.description: Which tree(s) `region` excuses from the totality check. Addresses are position-based, so an unchanged block usually has the identical address string on both trees -- `side` says which one this entry actually covers, so excusing one side never silently excuses the other too.

override_rate.description: Fraction of engine-proposed rows the labeller changed (status: corrected / total) -- the anti-self-marking symptom (ADR-0034).

signature.description: A digest of the label content as of signing, stamped by `label.py sign`, so a later edit invalidates the signature.

engine.description: The engine commit that reported this move.
